description:
Shared mailboxes have one copy of each message but per-identity read state. Current stoa-mail uses in-memory per-instance flags — this replaces that properly.

Schema:
  message_flags(mailbox_id FK, message_id, identity nullable, flag, PRIMARY KEY (mailbox_id, message_id, identity, flag))

identity = OIDC sub for personal flags (\Seen, \Flagged, user labels)
identity = NULL for shared flags (visible to all grantees)

Shared flag use case: $Assigned for team inbox triage — one team member marks a message as being handled, all others see it. $Assigned is a shared flag (identity NULL). \Seen is per-identity.

JMAP Email/get returns flags for the authenticated identity: WHERE identity = current_sub OR identity IS NULL.
JMAP Email/set flag changes: personal flags write identity = current_sub. Shared flags require write permission on mailbox.

Replaces current in-memory flag store entirely. Persists across restarts. Correct for multi-instance deployments (multiple stoa-mail instances sharing same SQLite or future distributed store).
title: design: per-identity message flags for shared mailboxes
